description: Runs every check the carriers care about on the saved registration, without submitting: missing or invalid form fields, and a live look at the person's website, privacy policy and terms (public, has the business name and address, and the privacy policy has the required sentence about mobile information). A few runs per 10 minutes. Use the results to help the person fix their form or their own site, then check again. Requires API key scope: account.
name: sms_website_check
title: Check the texting registration
